accounting.excludes: Directory metadata and small control-state reads are not counted; these are content bytes opened by the installed algorithm, not physical disk I/O.

cache: Caliente y no controlada: elegibilidad, verificacion de preguntas y preparacion leen el corpus antes de medir. Cada metodo ocupa una vez cada posicion por pregunta.

notMeasured.modelTokenUsage: No provider participates; token usage is not measured or estimated from bytes.
notMeasured.modelAnswerQuality: No model generates answers in this retrieval comparison.
notMeasured.physicalDiskIo: Content bytes opened by the algorithm are counted; filesystem metadata, cache and physical I/O are not.

limits: One installed application version on one Windows machine.
Public repositories are fixed samples, not a claim about all repositories.
Retrieval uses frozen literal queries; autonomous query selection is not measured.
Warm operating-system cache is not controlled; elapsed time is descriptive and each method occupies every order position.
Partial coverage and unsupported formats are product outcomes and are not repaired for this experiment.
